content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MPUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is being conducted by Maharana Pratap University of Agriculture & Technology (MPUAT), Udaipur, Rajasthan for filling various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under MPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for posts including Research Associate, Senior Research Fellow, Office Assistant, Crane & Tractor Operator, and Office Helper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for MPUAT jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to send any online or offline applications beforehand; they directly report to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 06 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary paperwork.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for Office Helper?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Helper post must have completed a minimum of 8th standard from a recognized board or school.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D in Farm Machinery and Power Engineering, or a 1st division Master Degree (M.E./M.Tech) in FMP along with 3 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for these positions?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official advertisement notification released by Maharana Pratap University of Agriculture & Technology.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Fellow post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month along with applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry a signed copy of your CV, recent passport-size photographs, original educational degree certificates, experience certificates, and valid photo ID proof.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification details?
faq.answer: You can check and download the official notification PDF by visiting the official university website at http://mpuat.ac.in or using the direct links provided above.
